newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Petroz says new discovery in Timor Sea.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Petroz says new discovery in Timor Sea.

text.p: Petroz NL said the Kakatua North-1A exploration well in the Timor Sea had encountered a gross hydrocarbon column of about 70 metres.
Petroz said the well, operated by the BHP Petroleum unit of Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, was expected to have a positive impact on development of the Elang/Kakatua oilfields in the Timor Gap.
Kakatua North-1A was located on a separate structure 1.1 kilometres to the north of the Kakatua-1 oil discovery, it said.
A core was cut over the interval 3,163-3,182 metres and wireline logging operations were now in progress.
"Preliminary analysis indicates that the objective section in the well is very similar to the Kakatua-1 well, which was drilled in 1994," Petroz said in a statement.
